notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
